description: Single occurrences across issues, newest first, or counts with group_by. Use it to answer which release or route an error hits, whether a person hit it, or what failed in one trace. Open one with get_error_event.

group_by.description: Counts per release, route, level, environment or tag:name

include_console.description: Also count console lines from the app. Always on with issue_id or trace_id

query.description: Text in the message, or the issue's title or culprit

since.description: An ISO time, or 30m, 24h, 7d. Default 30 days, or all kept events with issue_id or trace_id

user_id.description: An account id, Fictura user id or device id

name: search_error_events
title: Search error events
